findings.explanation: Shirou’s singular framing of Illya as the negotiating counterpart becomes plural dehumanization.
Dictionary-near “proper” misses Shirou’s intuitive judgment of Illya’s sound character.

findings.highlight: have hope for someone you haven’t met yet
findings.evidenceJa: まだ知らない者、これから出会う人間に希望を抱く
findings.governingReading: place hope in people I do not yet know, people I have yet to meet
findings.explanation: The paired categories of unknown and future-met people collapse into one.
Archer’s apparent abandonment of principle is reduced to changing sides.
The narrator’s affective descent becomes a vague change in cognition.

findings.evidenceJa: 頭の中が冷え切っていく
findings.governingReading: the inside of my head freezes solid
findings.explanation: The English can suggest calming down where the source depicts cold rage.

findings.governingReading: I am absolutely different from him
findings.explanation: Shirou’s declaration of identity is replaced by an invented oath and malformed spacing.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分が生き残る為のもの、最終的には正しい道
findings.governingReading: something done for one’s survival and ultimately the correct path
findings.explanation: Two concessions—personal survival and ultimate rightness—collapse into one instrumental choice.
Archer’s charge of empty moralizing becomes opposition to ideals themselves.

findings.governingReading: we had continually clashed with each other
findings.explanation: The reciprocal conflict between Shirou and Archer becomes one-sided resistance.

findings.highlight: The superhero my father talked about
findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣の言っていた正義の味方
findings.governingReading: the ally of justice Kiritsugu spoke of
findings.explanation: mirror moon replaces Kiritsugu’s explicit name and the central ideal with a generic family label and “superhero.”

findings.highlight: I won’t be able to keep standing
findings.governingReading: I will surely be unable to keep walking forward
findings.explanation: The path metaphor for Shirou’s continued moral course becomes physical standing.

findings.evidenceJa: 闇に溶けず、いつまでも残留した
findings.governingReading: do not dissolve into the darkness, but linger indefinitely
findings.explanation: The English invents a room as the container and drops the opposition between darkness and lasting words.

findings.evidenceJa: 泥のような眠りの中でさえ
findings.governingReading: even within sleep as heavy and inert as mud
findings.explanation: The closing image of exhausted, mud-like sleep disappears.
